Kotak Investment Banking Appoints New Leadership

Kotak Investment Banking has announced a leadership transition. Ramesh Srinivasan will move to the role of non-executive vice chairman. V. Jayasankar and Sourav Mallik have been appointed as the new managing directors and co-Chief Executive Officers, effective August 1.
